messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "total amount you take in a day stays the same"
set: ["total amount you take in a day stays the same", "take at the same time each day", "take same way each day", "take at around the same time each day", "same day", "take at same time every day", "take with food at the same time each day", "take once a day", "take about 30 minutes after the same meal each day", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "take orally once a day", "take once a day in the morning, with or without food", "take only the amount prescribed by your doctor", "hospital stays", "start nicotine replacement product on the same day you quit smoking", "do not take a missed dose during the day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
